pages.title: Best News App for Gen Z (2026)

pages.description: InSnaps Pro is $2.99/mo vs Ground News Vantage $99.99/yr, but it has no bias comparison or Blindspot. An honest, tier-by-tier comparison.

pages.description: Inshorts does 60-word text briefs, India-first. InSnaps adds narrated visual cards, any locality, and a mix you control. Free; Pro $2.99/mo.
